newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Denmark declines comment on BT talk.
newsitem.headline: Tele Denmark declines comment on BT talk.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark on Wednesday declined to comment on market talk that British giant BT intended to take a stake in the 51 percent state-owned Danish firm, possibly from a future government sale.
"In general we do not comment on whether or not the state might be considering selling its Tele Danmark shares or on rumours of possible buyers," a spokesman said.
Tele Danmark Chairman Knud Heinesen said in April that the state might reduce its holding in the coming months and its board was prepared to buy up to 10 percent of shares on offer.
The share closed at 335.00 crowns, up 14 crowns from Tuesday's close. The Copenhagen market is closed on Thursday for the Constitution Day market holiday.

BT, Tele Danmark and Norway's Telenor are equal partners in Swedish joint-venture Telenordia but the alliance was not reinforced with parent share swaps. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
